Class RenderInfo

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--model.RenderInfo
public class RenderInfo
extends java.lang.Object

This class contains information about how to render a DEditNode in the JTree.

Field Detail

styleBits

public int styleBits
The bits to be used for font style, an | of some combination of Font.PLAIN (0), Font.BOLD (1), and Font.ITALIC (2). Hence, 0-3.

textColor

public java.awt.Color textColor
The color to use to display the text.

synthesize

public static model.RenderInfo synthesize(model.RenderInfo[] ris)
Combines an array of RenderInfo's into one RenderInfo which can be used to display a DEditNode.

ris - the RenderInfos to join into one
Returns:

getDisplayString

public java.lang.String getDisplayString(java.lang.String displayName,
                                         java.lang.String nodeName,
                                         java.lang.String attributeVals,
                                         java.lang.String nodeValue)
Returns a String to use to display a node given a bunch of info about the node.

Parameters:
displayName - the result of DEditNode.getDisplayName()
nodeName - the result of DEditNode.getNode().getNodeValue();
attributeVals - a String representing DEditNode.getNode()'s attributes
nodeValue - a String representing DEditNode.getNodes()'s children of type TEXT_NODE
Returns:
a String to use to display a node given a bunch of info about the node

makeRenderInfo

public static model.RenderInfo makeRenderInfo(java.lang.String str)
Creates a RenderInfo from a string. It defaults to plain black text with a shown value if there is some error. See README for how to construct the string.

Parameters:
str - the String to make the RenderInfo from
Returns:
a RenderInfo constructed from a string.
